description: This file defines the UnsafeSortDataFormat class, which implements sorting logic for pairs of record pointers and key prefixes within the Spark framework. It provides methods for accessing, swapping, copying, and allocating data elements in a LongArray buffer, used in in-memory sorting operations.

classes.name: UnsafeSortDataFormat
classes.description: A class that supports sorting of (record pointer, key prefix) pairs stored in a LongArray buffer, used in Spark's in-memory sorting.

methods.name: UnsafeSortDataFormat
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer used for sorting.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Retrieves the key pair at a given position; throws UnsupportedOperationException if called directly.

methods.description: Creates a new instance of RecordPointerAndKeyPrefix.

methods.description: Retrieves the key pair at a given position, reusing an existing object.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps two elements in the LongArray buffer at specified positions.

methods.name: copyElement
methods.description: Copies a single element from source to destination LongArray.

methods.name: copyRange
methods.description: Copies a range of elements from source to destination LongArray using native memory copy.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a LongArray buffer of specified length, ensuring it is large enough.
